title: Primetime Emmy Awards 2026: See the full list of nominees
facts: The nominees for the 78th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards were announced on Wednesday.
The HBO Max medical drama 'The Pitt' led all programs with 25 Emmy nominations.
Apple TV series "Widow's Bay" received 19 Emmy nominations in the comedy categories.
Zendaya and Colman Domingo received acting nominations for their roles in the drama series 'Euphoria'.
The Canadian television production 'Heated Rivalry' was ineligible for Primetime Emmy consideration.
Connor Storrie received an Emmy nomination for his guest appearance on 'Saturday Night Live'.
Jean Smart has previously won four Emmy Awards for her portrayal of Deborah Vance in 'Hacks'.
Lisa Kudrow previously won an Emmy Award in 1998 in the supporting category for playing Phoebe Buffay in 'Friends'.
Actor Matthew Rhys stars as the mayor in the Apple TV series "Widow's Bay".
The television series 'The Bear' earned a nomination for outstanding comedy series.
Ayo Edebiri and Rob Reiner received Emmy nominations for their work on 'The Bear'.
Actor Jeremy Allen White was not nominated for an Emmy for 'The Bear' despite winning twice previously.
Matthew Rhys and Claire Danes received Emmy nominations for their roles in the limited series 'The Beast in Me'.
Keri Russell received an Emmy nomination for her role as a US ambassador in Netflix's 'The Diplomat'.
Mariska Hargitay will host the 78th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards on September 14 on NBC and Peacock.
